title: Spike: assistant-ui ExternalStoreRuntime on one DM channel
description:
## Goal
Prove assistant-ui in Chatticus web without replacing the backend.

## Scope
1. Add `@assistant-ui/react` (+ CLI shadcn-styled Thread if needed)
2. Map Chatticus `Message` + streaming turn progress → ThreadMessageLike via convertMessage
3. Wire `onNew` → existing `postMessage` + `openTurnStream` / startTurnStream behavior
4. Replace conversation transcript+composer in EnabledWorkspace (or a feature-flagged subcomponent) for a single selected bot DM
5. Keep roster, inspector, computer, org auth as-is

## Done when
- npm install + typecheck/tests pass
- Dev can open a bot DM and send/stream with assistant-ui Thread
- PR to develop documents mapping + known gaps (multi-bot channel address, tools, approvals)

## Refs
https://www.assistant-ui.com/docs/runtimes/custom/external-store
